scope.role: Named active V1Designer; owns design contract and peer design review through final gate; may update existing design doc to approved V1 contract. No app source writes.

task:
# Target
Platform both. Act as the named active designer V1Designer through every pre-integration gate. Own ONLY docs/design-language.md in assigned design worktree; no app code, Paper mutation, assets, config, tests or unrelated docs. Other workers implement frozen shared contract concurrently.
# Change
Read entire design-language.md and brandkit image and approved Feed export named in contract; update the existing design contract to reflect approved Indigo agency vs green success, exact five destinations, no meetups/events, faithful Feed grammar and native18+ handoff. Prune contradictory obsolete active design guidance, retaining useful established typography/components. Review remaining screen/interaction designs with NativeV1 and WebV1 and landing owner over Hub while they implement; preserve user scope and ban dead/fictional production states. Do not outsource overall architecture. New screens should use same editorial hierarchy, not clone competitor trade dress. Direct questions to Main for shared interface changes.
# Acceptance
Commit only owned doc. Return concise current design requirements and head. Remain reachable to review every exact data/native/web/landing/blender packet and actual screenshots later. Verdict exactly approved / changes requested: actionable findings / no visual impact: paths+reason. Never self-approve your doc packet (Main assigns independent designer review). Skip all validation/build/lint/tests/formatters; no extra artboards.
